One discrepancy chased to the ground and deliberately left alone: 545 entries are enabled in all.txt but only 544 ran. The missing one is munmap02, and it does not exist in the pinned LTP 20260529 at all -- /nix/store/hik6kb512ia3p14lc2vwzb292d4k306a-ltp-20260529 has no testcases/bin/munmap02 and its runtest/syscalls lists only munmap01, munmap03 and munmap04. So it is a stale all.txt entry from an older LTP, entirely pre-existing, unrelated to this patch, and it cannot be a regression because it never ran. Fixing it is out of scope for this run.

Tree state after the run is exactly the intended change and nothing else: the 6 kernel files plus all.txt, byte-identical to patch.diff, with only the untracked .osdk/ directory alongside. In particular phase 3's temporary KIRK_VERBOSE edit to run_ltp_test.sh is confirmed reverted -- that file is not modified.

Environment note for the commit phase, not a defect in the change: after this run, git commands inside the worktree started failing with 'fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at /root/asterinas/.worktrees/run-QEKFRT'. Cause is that /root/.gitconfig's safe.directory lists /root/asterinas but not the worktree path, while the tree is owned by uid 1001 and post-run tool calls execute as root. I worked around it per-invocation with `git -c safe.directory=/root/asterinas/.worktrees/run-QEKFRT ...` and did NOT modify global git config, so commit will likely need the same flag.
